主要内容: Sony reported a significant rise in profits, with a 346.4% increase in operating profit for its fiscal second quarter, driven by strong performance from the PlayStation gaming business and semiconductor division. The company's sales reached 2.06 trillion Japanese yen, surpassing expectations, and operating profit hit 204 billion yen, up from 135.6 billion yen. Sony also raised its dividend to 12.50 Japanese yen. The PlayStation division saw a 35.4% year-on-year rise in operating revenue, with a 188.3% increase in operating income. Major game titles like "FIFA 18" and "Unchartered: The Lost Legacy" contributed to this growth. Sony's semiconductor business also improved, with a profit of 49.4 billion yen, up from a 4.2 billion yen loss in the same period the previous year. The company's shares rose 2.7% following the results, and the stock has gained around 35% year-to-date. Sony reported a significant increase in profits, rising by 346%, largely due to the strong performance of its PlayStation division. The company has been focusing on innovation in areas such as virtual reality (VR) and artificial intelligence (AI). Sony CEO Kazuo Hirai emphasized the importance of innovation, stating that the company is committed to creating both traditional and new, sometimes wacky, products that excite consumers. This strategic focus on innovation and technology has contributed to Sony's recent financial success.
